summary: Daniel Mercereau of Moise in Saintonge, who married Suzanne Marie Doucinet of La Rochelle in 1693; John's 10th-great-grand-uncle.
bio:
Daniel Mercereau, described in the register as "du bourg de Moise en Xaintonge", married Suzanne Marie Doucinet, "de la ville de la Rochelle", on 6 August 1693. Among those who signed were Josué Mercereau, Elie Masse and Pierre Masse, and Elisabet Dubois made her mark. Daniel was close to the Masse family: he stood godfather to Daniel Masse in 1689, and his wife was godmother to Pierre Masse in 1693 and to Jeanne Masse in 1696.

Suzanne's origin in La Rochelle is probably the source of the mistaken family story that the Lamoureux family came from that city. Daniel was John's 10th-great-grand-uncle.
sources: Registers of the French Church of New York, Collections of the Huguenot Society of America vol. 1 (1886): https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu pp.29-31
